notes.title: Update V0.1.1 - Better Physics & More!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]My new machine arrived a whole week early, so I wasted no time setting it up and building out [b]version 0.1.1[/b].[/p][p]This update brings improvements to the [b]settings menu[/b], giving you more control over physics and time-of-day options:[/p][p][/p][h3]Breast Physics Settings[/h3][p]You can now tweak three key parameters:[/p][list][*][p][b]Dampening[/b]: controls how motion slows down[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elasticity[/b]: adjusts the bounce and rebound[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stiffness[/b]: fine-tunes overall firmness[/p][/*][/list][p]On top of that, there’s a new [b]Surface Physics[/b] toggle. Turn it on to add skin rippling effects when under pressure.[/p][p][/p][h3]Time of Day Options[/h3][p]Choose how the world looks and feels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Real-Time[/b] – syncs with your system clock[/p][/*][*][p][b]Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Night[/b] – pick a static time of day[/p][/*][*][p][b]Debug[/b] – cycles day/night super fast (originally built for testing lighting, but it’s surprisingly fun to watch!)[/p][/*][/list][p]That’s it for this round, but I’ve got more in the pipeline. Keep an eye on the news section for the next big update![/p]

notes.title: Trading cards & customizable boob physics are coming to BOOBS!
notes.content:
[h1]Trading cards are coming to BOOBS! [/h1][p][/p][p]Trading cards and community items are officially coming to [b]BOOBS[/b]!
I’m super proud to announce that Steam has selected BOOBS to include community items, a huge milestone for me personally. I never expected when I first started making a boob-touching game, that it'd be this successful. THANK YOU SO MUCH!!![/p][h3]
Trading Cards & Microtransactions[/h3][p]I’ve already created a set of trading cards, and they’ve been approved! The only catch is that free games can’t publish cards unless they have in-game microtransactions. My original plan was to release the next DLC, [b]“The Grabbing Hands”[/b], as a standalone package with new hand skins.[/p][p]Instead, I’ll be reworking this into an [b]in-game store[/b] where you can pick and choose which new hand styles you want to unlock. Not only does this give you more freedom (you don't have to buy all in 1 package), but it also allows BOOBS to have trading cards. And the best part? You’ll be able to sell them on the Steam Market and earn yourself some sweet Steam Wallet cash.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Hardware Incoming </3[/h3][p]On the less fun side, my old Legion 5 (2021) laptop gave up after the power connector broke (yes, I even tried soldering a new connector in which worked for a bit then broke again 😅). So I’ve ordered a brand-new development machine from Lenovo, which should arrive by [b]September 1st[/b]. Thankfully, I had full backups on a separate SSD (and of course versioning), so no progress was lost. This means however, that my hands are tied for the next one and a half weeks.[/p][h3]
Change BOOB physics in the next update![/h3][p]While I wait for my new rig, I’ve got an update ready to go on my SSD that I’ll release once I’m back in action. The most important thing this update brings is boob physics customization. Basically, you’ll be able to adjust firmness. There are three sliders that allow you to change how to the boobs jiggle. On top of that, you can choose to turn on or off skin deformation. Finally, you can change the time in the game. In the settings you can choose either Real-Time (syncs to your system clock) or choose from morning, afternoon, evening, night, or debug mode (for a speedy day/night cycle).  [/p][p][/p][p]So in short, new content is on the way and trading cards are coming! [/p]

notes.title: BOOBS is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content: [p]I’m incredibly proud to announce that [b]BOOBS is officially Steam Deck Verified![/b] Steam went through the checklist, ticked all the boxes, and BOOBS got the highest compatibility rating, which means you can enjoy the full experience smoothly on Valve’s amazing handheld.[/p][p]I’m a big fan of the Steam Deck myself. I picked one up earlier this year, and whenever I’m not busy developing games, I’m usually playing them on my Deck. Honestly, it feels like a revolution for PC gaming and for Steam as a platform, so this milestone means a lot to me.[/p][p]Now you can play with your [b]BOOBS[/b] on the go! (Just… maybe not in public, lol).[/p]

notes.title: Tentacle Touch DLC, CUMPLETE EDITION Bundle & Launch Discount
notes.content:
[p][b]Tentacle Touch DLC, CUMPLETE EDITION Bundle & Launch Discount[/b][/p][p]It’s been a long time coming, but it’s finally here: [b]BOOBS’ second DLC pack[/b] has officially launched!
With this update, you can now pick the [b]tentacle[/b] straight from the toolbox. This was one of the most requested features from my Patreon supporters, and for good reason: the slippery tentacle glides, wraps, and whips for maximum [i]boob-based[/i] fun. The [b]Tentacle Touch DLC[/b] even comes with its own set of achievements to unlock.[/p][p]And now that there are two DLC packs available, I’ve bundled them together!
Grab the [b]“Complete Your Collection”[/b] bundle and get an extra [b]10% off[/b] — and yes, that discount stacks with the launch offer.[/p][p][/p][p]You can find the bundle here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57874/BOOBS__CUMPLETE_EDITION/" style="button"]CUMPLETE EDITION[/url].  [/p][p][/p][p]Stay posted as I have some more fantastic news coming soon![/p]

notes.title: BOOBS v0.1.0 is live! (Yes… I skipped v0.0.9)
notes.content:
[p]First off, a massive thank you to everyone who has shared feedback and supported the game so far. Your input has been invaluable in shaping where BOOBS is headed, and I’m thrilled to share what’s new.[/p][p]Over the past couple of weeks, I’ve been working hard on a brand-new DLC—details are still under wraps for now, but there’s already a little hint waiting for you in-game. 👀[/p][p]Here’s a quick rundown of what’s improved in v0.1.0:[/p][list][*][p][b]Controller navigation overhaul:[/b] The menu controls with a controller felt clunky and confusing, so I’ve reworked the UI flow. Navigation is now straightforward—just use the D-pad, simple and intuitive.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement fixes:[/b] Some achievements weren’t unlocking properly before. That’s now fully resolved, so you should see them popping up as intended.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced breast physics:[/b] This update brings more natural weight and motion, plus improved softbody physics when undressed (Nudity DLC required). For the physics enthusiasts: in addition to bone-based animation, breasts now respond with softbody deformation—press into the skin and you’ll feel the difference. It’s something you really have to see in-game!

[/p][/*][/list][p]The bulk of my time has gone into finishing the new DLC, which is currently in Steam’s review queue. As soon as it’s approved, I’ll be rolling it out![/p][p]Thanks again for playing and for all the feedback. You’re helping make every update better than the last.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: SNEAK PREVIEW: VERY early look at something new I'm working on... 𐂠
BOOBS V0.0.8 is here!
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to everyone who’s played and shared feedback — I’ve gone through all of it and made a bunch of improvements and fixes in this update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Improvements & Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Slap Achievements:[/b] Now track your [b]total slaps[/b], not just your current session.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slap Counter:[/b] Your [b]total slap count is saved and loaded[/b], and you can now see how many slaps you’ve done in your current session.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hair Rendering Fix:[/b] Hair no longer renders behind clothes — it should now look as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Boost:[/b] The game runs [b]way smoother[/b] now. On the Steamdeck I managed to double the frame rate, though optimizing for Steamdeck is different than optimizing for regular PCs. So optimization on Steamdeck still needs some work. Funnily enough, the game runs better under proton than it does on native linux, so you may want to consider running the game through proton until I optimize the game for Steamdeck in a later update. (Though saves don't carry over from native linux to proton and vice versa, so be careful there.) [/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu:[/b] You can now change and save:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sound volume[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Windowed/fullscreen mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Screen resolution (including, Steamdeck, 1440p and ultra wide screen)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Proper Game Exit:[/b] The game now cleanly exits and communicates with Steam like it should.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing BOOBS! I’ve got so many fun ideas lined up for new ways to play with BOOBS — can’t wait to share more soon! [url="https://emojigraph.org/octopus/"]🐙[/url]💦[/p]

If you run into any more issues, please post it in the discussion boards. I'm monitoring them <3. [/p]

notes.title: BOOBS – Launch Announcement!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]I’m thrilled to announce the release of my latest project: [b]BOOBS [/b]– a game that’s exactly what it sounds like. This is a playful, soothing, and yes, a bit cheeky experience designed to help you unwind in the most [i]hands-on[/i] way possible.[/p][h3]What It’s All About[/h3][p]BOOBS is meant to be a simple escape – something you can open up after a long day and just zone out with. You get to interact with a beautifully rendered, physics-driven pair of boobs in a calm and peaceful environment. Think of it like a stress ball... but softer, warmer, and way more fun.[/p][p]Features:[/p][list][*][p][b]Interactive Gameplay with Realistic Physics[/b] – Use your mouse (or controller!) to grab, jiggle, and bounce with smooth, lifelike motion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Life-like Reactions[/b] – She responds in real-time to how you touch and interact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optional Nudity[/b] – Unlock the full experience if that’s what you’re after through the DLC.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Relaxing Atmosphere[/b] – A tranquil beach setting with ocean waves and blue skies for maximum chill.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b] – Full dual-stick interaction so you can use both hands.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Achievements[/b] – Earn achievements for, well… let’s just say, various milestones.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Why I Made This[/h3][p]Honestly? I wanted to make something that doesn’t take itself too seriously, but still feels well-crafted and satisfying to use. It’s silly, sensual, and surprisingly therapeutic. Whether you’re here for the relaxation, the adult content, or just the novelty – I appreciate you checking it out.[/p][p]Your feedback, suggestions, and ideas are always welcome (yes, even the weird ones). Leave a review if you like it – or just come say hi in the discussions![/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p]
